description: Collects your group's last 50 ARAM Mayhem games from PlayARAM profile pages you open in your own browser, and syncs them straight to the leaderboard (or downloads one file if you haven't saved a token yet). It only reads pages you opened — it makes no requests of its own to PlayARAM, and it never tries to get past a security check.
name: ARAM Mayhem Collector
